name: @thetis/reflections
description: Reflections: when you archive a conversation, a model reads all of it once, writes down what was tried and what it did, and keeps at most one lesson that transfers, as a skill.

thetis.label: reflections
thetis.summary: Learns from your archived conversations: what worked, what did not, and one lesson for next time.

model.help: The model that reflects. Unset means the server's default model. Reflection reads the whole conversation once, so a stronger model writes better lessons.

maxTokens.help: The longest answer one reflection may write, in tokens: the rows of what was tried and the lesson. Reasoning counts against it on models that think.

minTurns.help: A conversation with fewer of your messages than this is not reflected on when you archive it; it is marked "Skipped: too short" and Reflect still works.

observationChars.help: How much of one tool result the reflection reads, in characters; the rest is cut from the middle and marked. Never below 10000: a build log's error is at its end.

inputChars.help: How much of a conversation one reflection reads, in characters (about a quarter of that in tokens). Past it the middle is left out, said to be, and the reflection is marked partial.

dailyCostUsd.help: The most automatic reflections may spend in one day (UTC), in US dollars. Past it an archive is marked "Skipped: daily cost cap reached"; Reflect still runs when you press it.

enabled.help: Reflect automatically when you archive a conversation. Off, nothing is reflected unless you press Reflect. A single project can be switched off in the Reflections place.

places.label: Reflections
places.hint: What your archived conversations taught, and the lessons kept from them

commands.label: Read and change reflections and lessons
